# Cloud Dancer

Cloud Dancer is built on a soft off-white Cloud Dancer palette with a complementary dark mode in deep warm charcoal. It uses terracotta accents, clean typography, subtle transitions, refined scrollbars and pill-styled tags.

![Cloud Dancer screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pierry/obsidian-cloud-dancer-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Cloud Dancer"
    author: "pierry"
    repo:   "pierry/obsidian-cloud-dancer-theme"
    slug:   "cloud-dancer"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/cloud-dancer"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/pierry/obsidian-cloud-dancer-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pierry/obsidian-cloud-dancer-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["light", "dark"]
    about: "Apply a warm, elegant theme built on a soft off-white Cloud Dancer palette with a complementary dark mode in deep warm charcoal. Use terracotta accents, clean typography, subtle transitions, refined scrollbars, and pill-styled tags for comfortable, readable notes."
}
```
